common.style_usage: the exact Stardew Valley town building style and PIXEL SCALE of these houses: doors, windows, boards and shingles must be exactly this size; square-on front view from above
reference_images: layout and outline: a steep gable roof rising to a central peak, a cream triangular gable face with a small window, the big window left and the full-size arched door right below; keep this size, shape and layout exactly

the look AND THE SHAPE to keep: this cottage's steep front gable with its cream triangle face, sage shingle roof slopes, stone chimney, arched door with a round window, ivy on the left corner, pink flower box; draw the same shape at the reference houses' larger pixel scale

cottage_v4a.description: Stardew Valley town building at exactly the pixel scale of the reference houses: a small cottage six tiles wide and six tall, drawn square-on from the front and above, shaped like a steep front-gabled cottage: sage green shingled roof slopes rising to a peak in the middle, a cream boarded triangular gable facing us with a small window, a small stone chimney. Below, the face we see is the back of the house: a big multi-paned picture window with a pink flower box, and at the right an arched wooden door with a small round window, exactly as big as the doors of the reference houses. Ivy climbing the left corner. Dark coloured (not black) outlines, transparent background
